# hestiacp_web_domain_httpauth (Resource)

Adds HTTP basic authentication to a HestiaCP web domain.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_password` (String, Sensitive) HTTP basic auth password.
- `auth_user` (String) HTTP basic auth username.
- `domain` (String) Web domain to protect.

### Optional

- `user` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
